products.name: The Open Source Student — Core eBook
products.description: The Open Source Student is a practical digital guide that helps learners and educators build real-world AI and open-source skills through step-by-step workflows and implementation checklists. This Core edition includes the main book in PDF + EPUB plus a Student Setup Checklist.

products.name: The Open Source Student — Founder Bundle
products.description: The Founder Bundle includes the full multi-format learning system for builders, educators, and operators who want implementation-ready assets. Includes PDF/EPUB/DOCX/HTML formats plus operational guides and the Founder Complete Edition package.

products.name: The Open Source Student — Team License (Up to 10 Seats)
products.description: Team/Institution license for up to 10 users, designed for schools, nonprofits, and workforce programs. Includes the Founder Bundle plus LMS-ready delivery assets (HTML + SCORM) for structured training environments.
